units.source_text: 鹤川的解释总是这样，充满了对我的误解。

en.t: Tsurukawa's explanations were always like this, full of misunderstandings about me.

units.source_text: 然而，他一点也不使我讨厌，并且成了我所必需的人。

en.t: Yet he did not make me dislike him at all, and he became someone I needed.

units.source_text: 他的确是我的善意的翻译，把我的语言翻译成现今的语言，他是我难得的朋友。

en.t: He was truly my well-meaning interpreter, translating my language into the language of the present day; he was a rare friend to me.
